script.code:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS busy_count
  FROM stock_adjustment g
 WHERE g.tenant_id = '{{node:code_node_SCguard.data.tenantId}}'
   AND g.stock_count_id = {{node:code_node_SCguard.data.scId}}
   AND {{node:code_node_SCguard.data.scId}} > 0
   AND g.stock_adjustment_status = 'Processing'
   AND g.is_deleted = 0

script.code:
SELECT c.src,
       CAST(c.material_id AS CHAR) AS material_id,
       CAST(c.plant_id AS CHAR) AS plant_id,
       CAST(c.batch_id AS CHAR) AS batch_id,
       c.cost,
       c.rn,
       c.rn_any
FROM (
  SELECT 'WA' AS src, w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id, w.wa_cost_price AS cost,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id, w.batch_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY w.material_id, w.plant_id
                            ORDER BY w.create_time DESC, w.id DESC) AS rn_any
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_review_prep.data.materialIdCsv}}', ']'),
                  '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
  JOIN wa_costing_method w ON w.material_id = sel.mid
  WHERE w.is_deleted = 0 AND w.organization_id = '{{node:code_review_prep.data.orgIdSql}}'
    AND w.wa_cost_price > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'FIFO', f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id, f.fifo_cost_price,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id, f.batch_id
                            ORDER BY CAST(f.fifo_sequence AS UNSIGNED) DESC, f.id DESC),
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY f.material_id, f.plant_id
                            ORDER BY f.create_time DESC, f.id DESC)
  FROM JSON_TABLE(CONCAT('[', '{{node:code_review_prep.data.materialIdCsv}}', ']'),
                  '$[*]' COLUMNS (mid BIGINT PATH '$')) sel
  JOIN fifo_costing_history f ON f.material_id = sel.mid
  WHERE f.is_deleted = 0 AND f.organization_id = '{{node:code_review_prep.data.orgIdSql}}'
    AND f.fifo_cost_price > 0
) c
WHERE c.rn = 1 OR c.rn_any = 1

const saResult = {{node:add_node_sa.data}}[0];
return { stockAdjustmentId: saResult ? saResult.id : "", stockAdjustmentNo: saResult ? saResult.adjustment_no : "" };
